definitions.entry: signal bar completion = next continuous bar opening; entry bar counts as horizon bar 1
definitions.BUY: endpoint BID close minus entry ASK open
definitions.SELL: entry BID open minus endpoint ASK close
definitions.favorable: max(0, max BID high-entry ASK) BUY; max(0, entry BID-min ASK low) SELL
definitions.adverse: max(0, entry ASK-min BID low) BUY; max(0, max ASK high-entry BID) SELL
definitions.window: entry bar through horizon bar inclusive; ending at a boundary allowed, crossing forbidden
definitions.independence: overlapping signals retained; not independent or a portfolio backtest
